inductance.question: What is the frequency range represented on the x-axis of the chart?
inductance.reasoning_path: The visible numeric values on the x-axis (1, 3, 5, ..., 19) and the context of the chart suggest that these numbers represent frequencies. The 'x10^4' multiplier can be inferred from the scientific notation convention and the scale of the data.
inductance.why_inferable: The numeric values and scientific notation conventions provide sufficient clues to deduce the meaning of the x-axis label.
inductance.expected_behavior: Model should attempt to infer from visual context
